question: Can a single affine scalar m=u^T h+c replace the two-tanh opponent modulation head while retaining learned relational competence, individualized organization and A/C compensation? What modulation and write opportunities do the frozen reference networks actually use?

design.crossing: All three training pairs crossed with all three panels. Only three independent training pairs. Identical initialization and base task stream within A/C pair. Identical physical input, observation draw, choice RNG and interventions across four cells within panel.

statistics.unit: Joint resampling of the original participant IDs across four cells within each network; generic episodes and Liu participants separate. Never treat participant pairs as independent or pool networks. Duplicate sampled IDs are separate bootstrap observations as in the parent contract. Conditional masks applied after resampling, no common-mask restriction. Any undefined conditional draw makes its interval undefined; retain its count. Scalar CE and shifts must be finite for all subjects or stop.

estimands.tau: For each contrast, recompute the weighted pairwise Kendall tau of each cell in shared-ID bootstrap samples. Primary global_all77; also full_all77, full_conditional and global_conditional. Report each cell and simple effects, not interaction alone.
estimands.CE: Per-episode CE=mean(logaddexp(0,-margin*true_sign/T)). Generic T=1, full/global separately; global CE interaction aligns with primary structure and full CE retains task-output context. Liu T=0.25, full/global separately as secondary; never pool tasks or temperatures. All four simple/cross contrasts for each endpoint.
estimands.order_shift: Global S_R=mean_i[(1-KendallTau(order_R0_i,order_Re_i))/2], equivalently fraction of the 28 item pairs reversed within each subject. Report S_A,S_C and participant-paired S_C-S_A using replay0, deterministic internal orders, unchanged tie ordering. No sampled choices enter this endpoint.
estimands.absolute_behavior: Retain inherited full/global competence and five core flags for each cell, plus P_off/evidence-shuffle evidence binding. Full-policy historical profiles remain descriptive; no promotion or human-distribution matching.

change: Only modulation head changes: m=h2DA(h) with output_size1, no output tanh or separate DAmult. Preserve current recurrent equations, old-eligibility timing, P clipping[-50,50], eta, regularizer, q generation and duplicated(q,q) training interface. No new gate, local memory, loss, temperature or training stage.
references: Use six frozen D=(q,q) two-tanh models and36 archived cells as immediate reference, original15 inputs by reference. Train only six new single-affine models at2531/2532/2533, clean/noisy,1500x32 each;36 units across the same three exposed panels. No independent confirmation.

noninferiority.orientation: single affine modulation minus frozen two-tanh duplicate-observation reference, full-policy mean correct probability
noninferiority.statistics: Paired complete-case participant bootstrap within panel and endpoint. Missing omitted subjects are excluded before resampling in both models, with counts/IDs reported. Equal average of three panel differences within network, independent panel resampling; no network pooling. Lower95>=-.02 supports practical noninferiority; upper95<-.02 supports material inferiority; otherwise unresolved. CE is reported separately, no new CE tolerance.

decision.competence: Retain unchanged full/global generic and Liu learned/nonlearned lower95>.5 gates per cell. Invalid units do not support structure claims. Complete all models and all36 units unless integrity/nonfinite failure.
decision.core: Retain all five flags and historical nine descriptive rows, with conditional sampled diversity distinct from primary global all77 tau. Report all cells, failures and per-network core counts; do not require exact parent pass counts.
decision.compensation: Repeat the parent four-cell estimates and equal-panel summaries for linear-modulation models. Report candidate-minus-opponent differences of all equal-panel contrast effects with shared panel draw IDs. Main I_tau>0,I_CE<0,S_C-S_A<0 with both noise tau effects negative; do not require effect magnitudes equal to reference.
decision.preference: Development linear-modulation replacement support requires all six trained models competent in their tested cells, all three Ce equal-panel five-endpoint noninferiority comparisons supported, core Ae and Ce each present on at least one panel in each of three networks, and all three network equal-panel main compensation intervals oriented as expected with negative noise simple effects. Evidence binding must be retained in every Ae/Ce cell. This bounded sufficiency rule is not a population success-rate claim; retain exact heterogeneous core counts and uncertain intervals.
decision.otherwise: Preserve all competence, behavior, probability and compensation outcomes. No R2 gate, seed repair, gain tuning or extra steps. If a clear functional/performance/stability problem appears, a separately frozen single-tanh diagnostic may distinguish saturation from two-drive structure. Broad uncertain intervals alone do not establish failure or justify tuning. No automatic mainline promotion or universal necessity claim.

execution.freezes: Commit qualified source and protocol; lock source, physical inputs and frozen reference artifacts before reference audit or training. Complete read-only reference audit before training; it cannot alter candidate. Complete and commit all six final model locks before new evaluation. Verify all9000 input fingerprints and all common initial tensors against reference. Evaluate36 units once, summarize, conditionally export, archive.
execution.qualification: CPU/GPU independent equation-level forward, old-eligibility update order, gradient and Adam checks; clip boundary fixture; exact common initialization and RNG preservation; original duplicate collector replay versus105 archived A0/2531/panel1 arrays; fixed non-Liu compact mapping check.
execution.validation: Changed-file Ruff/format/type checks, affected numerical/statistical tests, architecture and documentation/registry checks. Focused independent checks of masks, paired probabilities and registered decision from saved summaries. No new estimands or repeated scientific evaluation beyond the frozen compact equivalence check.

outputs: reference modulation/write audit with compact scalar trajectories
canonical four-cell result, affine-minus-opponent performance and compensation, original-dual cumulative Ce costs
conditional six mapped37-channel checkpoints and numerical equivalence record
claim_boundary: Three paired training instances and exposed references/panels; development sufficiency, no network pooling or independent confirmation.
Only output parameterization changes; input(q,q) training, one persistent P and p/z observation generation remain.

Reference audit describes use of old heads on one existing panel. Small signal fit error or saturation fractions do not establish dispensability; from-scratch comparison tests learnability under this recipe.

Linear head may shift hidden representations and optimizer trajectories; success does not show old two-head solutions were globally linearly representable. Failure cannot establish universal need for two drives.
No human biological dopamine identification, no second-stage distillation, no frozen-source edits or mainline promotion.
cumulative_cost: Secondary descriptive Ce linear-modulation minus original dual probability for the same five groups, paired participant bootstrap and equal-panel means separately per network. Report intervals directly; do not infer cumulative noninferiority from successive deletion gates or add a new selection threshold.

compact_export.trigger: Only if all three paired instances support the unchanged replacement rule against the two-tanh reference.
compact_export.mapping: Add trained input weight column34 into column37, then delete column34 in weights and inputs. Preserve bias, all other parameters and state dimensions. Original0..33->0..33,35->34,36->35,37(q)->36. Assert columns34/37 identical before mapping; both query columns zero. Study-specific37-channel ABI, not historical37. No optimizer-state mapping or second training.
compact_export.validation: All six models, both observation conditions, three panels and five input archives: compare intact generic/Liu logits, final P, first P, costs and writes; Liu also P_off, evidence-shuffle and each relation-removal control. Inherited atol1e-5 rtol1e-4, exact argmax and internal complete-graph order for intact and support interventions; exact argmax for P_off. Stop on mismatch, no tolerance adjustment. Export only as a numerically qualified representation.
compact_export.boundary: Floating-point inference equivalence only. Two trained parameter columns and Adam/clipping need not equal single-column training.

initialization: Construct the complete old model at each original seed first, preserving every common parameter and RNG state. Replace only h2DA with u0=DAmult0*(w1-w2), c0=DAmult0*(b1-b2); absorb and remove DAmult. This is the first-order small-preactivation map, NOT exact functional equivalence to nonlinear head. Check common parameter hashes and head mapping before training; full A/C initial states exact. Adam states start fresh, unchanged optimizer settings.

reference_audit.scope: Frozen reference six models, both observation conditions, original panel1 only, all four generic test archives and Liu; no parameter updates or outcome-based candidate changes. Replay support with actual old eligibility and P clipping; preserve scalar per-step evidence and existing ownership.
observables: Frobenius norm of alpha*old eligibility before write
fraction of proposed entries exceeding original P clip
trial and within-trial phase including initial blank sequence
reference_audit.descriptive_thresholds: Report both |a|,|b|<=0.25; both |tanh|>=0.95 with same sign; near-zero |m|/(2*abs(DAmult))<=0.05; eligibility-active norm>1e-12. These are descriptive bins fixed before audit, never replacement gates. Report continuous quantiles/correlation and RMS(a+b)/RMS(a-b) as well.
reference_audit.weighting: In addition to unweighted fractions, weight indicators by ||alpha*Eold||_F^2, exposing when modulation suppresses a potential effective connection update. Compute analytic open-loop relative squared write error for m_linear=DAmult*(a-b), with fixed original states, before clipping. This is not fitted surrogate R2 or a closed-loop causal claim.
reference_audit.integrity: No slow parameter changes. Compare eager observed support P_T and query logits against the unchanged compiled reference rollout at original atol1e-5 rtol1e-4. Preserve compact scalar arrays by model/cell; no full hidden/P histories required.
